Common questions

Are you tied to one bank?

No. We are independent and have access to a wide range of lenders via our network.

Is the first meeting free?

Yes. The initial consultation is at no cost and no obligation. We explain our fees before you proceed.

What documents will I need?

Typically proof of ID, address, last three months payslips (or accounts if self-employed), bank statements and existing mortgage details.
